listing.name: Portrait Faction Expanded
listing.summary: A collection of portraits available to the player and Vanilla factions.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 140 new portraits for all vanilla factions and the player.

description:
PORTRAIT FACTION EXPANDED

A collection of portraits available to the player and Vanilla factions.

Enjoy!

Download here

140 new portraits for all vanilla factions and the player.

Preview

Disclaimer
Older Portraits (55 of them) were created with Stable Difussion with Severian Void's model and edited with Gimp, and then further edited again with Krita in 2025
New Portraits were created using Severian Void's Lora and then edited with Krita

Changelog
- 28 new Portraits, 14 of them replacing existing ones
- Replaced portraits are present in an Extra folder for you to add if you liked them

Credits
Alex and David - For the base game Artwork
Severian Void - For training and creating the Stable Diffusion Model and lora for Starsector Portraits

140 new portraits in total available to the player and Vanilla factions.

Enjoy!

AI notice
Older Portraits (55 of them) were created with Severian Void's old model https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25550.0 and edited with Gimp, and then further edited again with Krita
New Portraits were created using Severian Void's Lora https://civitai.com/models/1072230/starsector-portraits-advanced-lora and then edited with Krita

Download: https://github.com/Alexeyov/PFE-Hegemony/releases/download/1.0.1/Portrait_Faction_Expanded.zip
